name: Macdsignal
description: This keyword returns the MACD Signal Line value of any series of the selected Instrument in any timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the MACD Signal Line value of any series of the selected Instrument in any timeframe. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632222686.png)

You can plot MACD Signal line on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot MACD Signal line based on series of RSI, OPEN etc

Moving average convergence divergence (MACD) is a trend-following momentum indicator that shows the relationship between two moving averages of a security’s price.

Read more about MACD here -  https://www.investopedia.com/terms/m/macd.asp
